caption: The drawing depicts a wooden desk viewed from the back. The desk is rectangular in form with a slightly curved feature at the back top edge. The body of the desk is rendered in shades of brown to represent the wood grain, with darker shading indicating depth and corners. There are three drawers along the back, each with a keyhole, and the central drawer is wider than the two on either side. On the top surface of the desk is a large rectangular section depicted in light blue or gray, suggesting a glass or writing pad inset. The sides of the desk extend downward and slightly outward, forming the legs and base of the structure, and the drawing is framed by a thin, faintly visible pencil line. Beneath the desk illustration, notation in pencil reads, “No. 1 Back View of Desk.” The background is plain and beige, matching the color of the paper.
title: Desk
